text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tanino Gimlet ceased appearing in the 
media after the Japanese Derby. Even so, 
the spotlight on her only continued to 
grow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As things stand, expectations are higher 
for her than for Symboli Kris S. To prove 
Symboli Kris S's true strength, a major 
"result" is necessary.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thus, the premier race where she would 
compete against Senior-class runners, the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn), became a candidate for 
their next goal. It was sure to be a tough 
race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To demonstrate her resolve, Symboli Kris S 
ran the same 2,000 meters as the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn) at full throttle. She then voiced 
her determination to emerge victorious at 
all costs.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, Tanino Gimlet was told 
she would be entering the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn). But her reaction felt somewhat 
cold.
